text: 证监会最新消息显示，英大期货获批变更股权、实控人，此次变更后，英大期货成为中国石油集团资本有限责任公司成为的全资子公司，出资额仍为6.58亿元，公司实际控制人变更为中国石油天然气集团有限公司。英大期货仍需依法办理变更登记等相关事宜。早在去年12月，国网英大曾宣布，全资子公司英大证券拟将所持英大期货100%股权，以11.29亿元的价格出售给中油资本，今年1月，国务院国资委同意此次股权出售。
text_en: The CSRC announced that Yingda Futures has received approval for a change in equity and actual controller. After the change, Yingda Futures becomes a wholly-owned subsidiary of CNPC Capital, with the same registered capital of 658 million yuan, and the actual controller becomes China National Petroleum Corporation. Yingda Futures must still handle registration procedures. Last December, State Grid Yingda announced that its subsidiary Yingda Securities would sell all 100% of Yingda Futures to CNPC Capital for 1.129 billion yuan, and the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission approved the sale this January.
